name: Hotel Schloß Fernsteinsee
beschreibung: Hotel Schloß Fernsteinsee is nestled directly beside the emerald waters of Lake Fernsteinsee in the Fern Pass region near Nassereith. Dating back to the 12th century, this historic castle property pairs aristocratic heritage with contemporary comfort. Guests enjoy exclusive private lake access, world-class freshwater diving, and scenic forest walks. Property highlights include an acclaimed castle restaurant, an artisanal pastry shop, and romantic lakeside suites.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Schloß Fernsteinsee near Nassereith on the Fern Pass offers romantic castle accommodation, private lake access, historic charm, and renowned dining.
